name: GitHub

field_reviews.reason: GitHub documents PATs, OAuth apps, and GitHub Apps (JWT -> installation tokens) for REST API auth; the OAuth/GitHub-App user authorization uses the authorization code (web application) flow, so listing it as the primary user-facing grant is reasonable, and the draft's uncertainty note about GitHub steering integrators to GitHub Apps is accurate.

All documented: fine-grained/classic PATs, OAuth web flow, device flow, GitHub App JWTs, and basic auth (client_id/client_secret) on a few app-management endpoints, per docs.github.com REST authentication docs (draft evidence URL confirmed live via the About the REST API page linking directly to it).
Free accounts can mint PATs, register OAuth Apps, and create GitHub Apps without any approval process — long-standing, confirmed by the getting-started/authentication docs.

Clearly correct — the REST API is organized into per-resource endpoint categories (issues, releases, actions, orgs, etc.) covering the whole platform — but the draft attached no evidence URL to the api claim. Replacement evidence found: the official About the REST API page describing endpoint categories and automation use cases.

Correct but previously unevidenced: REST confirmed at docs.github.com/en/rest; GraphQL confirmed via the official 'Comparing GitHub's REST API and GraphQL API' page linked from it (docs.github.com/en/graphql is the API guide); MCP via the official github/github-mcp-server remote server. Same replacement evidence as api_breadth.

github/github-mcp-server is the official GitHub-org-owned MCP server (remote hosted with OAuth 2.1 or PAT, plus local Docker image) — repo ownership under the github org verified. Composio GITHUB toolkit listing matches the draft's catalog citation.
Free self-serve accounts, instant tokens, broad documented API — nothing blocks building today.
No blocker; only standard rate limits apply.

notes: Independently fetched the official About the REST API page (confirms REST endpoint breadth, links to the GraphQL comparison and the draft's authentication evidence URL) and the github/github-mcp-server repo ownership. The only draft gap was the missing evidence URL on the api claim (api_breadth/api_protocols); replacement evidence supplied. All values stand as drafted.
